{{Top|leg}}
A '''thread master''' was a [[Balinaka]] [[Artisan/Legends|artisan]] who was part of the process of creating [[Garnib crystal]]. The thread masters wove fragments of gems and glass into a molecular string that was inlaid into the crystal.
